set.q: Which nation did the prophet Amos condemn for burning the bones of Edom's king to lime?
Which king of Judah rebuilt altars to Baal and made an Asherah pole, as Ahab had done?
Who rebuilt Jericho at the cost of his oldest and youngest sons?
Which king of Israel bought the hill of Samaria and built the city there?
Which prophet is quoted in Romans 9 about God calling those who were 'not my people' his people?
Who laughed at Jesus when he said Jairus' daughter was only asleep?
At whose feet did Paul say he was educated?
Which companion of Paul did he call 'the beloved physician'?
Which valley outside Jerusalem, linked with child sacrifice, gave its name to 'Gehenna'?
Which servant of the church in Cenchreae did Paul commend to the Romans?
Who is called God's friend in both Isaiah 41:8 and James 2:23?
Which two men, with their households, were swallowed by the earth after rebelling with Korah against Moses?
Counting words in the original Greek, which is the shortest book in the Bible?
Counting Luke and Acts together, which New Testament writer wrote the most words?
